members.name: banking_intents_0
members.instructions: Which intent best describes this customer message sent to a digital bank's support chat? Choose the single most specific intent. Consider the exact topic (card vs cash withdrawal vs transfer vs top-up), and whether the customer is asking how/why something works, or reporting a problem.

criteria.activate_my_card: customer has a new card and asks how to activate / start using it
criteria.age_limit: asks about minimum age or age requirement to open an account
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: any question that mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up with them, top up not working via Apple Pay, adding a card (even Amex) to a mobile wallet
criteria.atm_support: asks where ATMs are, which ATMs accept or can be used with the card, do all ATMs accept the card
criteria.automatic_top_up: asks about automatic / recurring top-up, setting up or disabling auto top up
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: balance did not update / money not showing up or 'not here yet' after a bank transfer; customer made a transfer and asks whether it went through / why it is not showing in the account; asks why balance update is taking long
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: money deposited / paid in to the account but balance did not update or it is not showing up (generic 'deposit' not showing counts here), cheque or cash deposit
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: transfer to a beneficiary / recipient / account is not allowed, not cleared, or cannot be received because of the beneficiary; 'the transfer to an account wasn't allowed, is there another way?', 'what happens when a beneficiary can't receive my transfer?', 'my account transfer was not cleared'
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or undo a transfer they made
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card is expiring soon or has expired; how to get a replacement / renew
criteria.card_acceptance: where is the card accepted, can it be used at merchants / shops / countries for payment
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet, where is my card, tracking a card in the post
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long will card delivery take, delivery time or cost for a card
criteria.card_linking: linking or connecting a card to the app or account; re-linking a card, including a lost/stolen or replaced card
criteria.card_not_working: card does not work, general problem using the card (not specifically contactless, virtual, or declined payment)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: asks about or complains of a fee/extra charge for paying with the card or for card purchases in general ('charged extra for using my card', 'fee for payments')
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment shows on the account that the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment (purchase) abroad
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept / swallowed / ate the card
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: charged a fee for a cash withdrawal, ATM fees
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: cash withdrawal on the account that the customer didn't make / doesn't recognise; app shows a cash amount or withdrawal that the customer did not receive; card used without permission at an ATM
criteria.change_pin: wants to change PIN or set a new PIN, forgot the PIN and wants to reset it
criteria.compromised_card: card details compromised, someone using the card without permission, fraud on the card (not physically lost)
criteria.country_support: asks which countries the service/account/card is available in or supported in; can people outside the UK / in a given country get an account or card; can the card be mailed to a named country or region (e.g. 'Can the card be mailed to Europe?')
criteria.declined_card_payment: a card payment was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or rejected; card does not work at an ATM
criteria.declined_transfer: a transfer was declined or rejected, or the customer is told a transfer is 'not possible' (e.g. 'suddenly being told it is not possible')
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit payment the customer doesn't recognise or didn't authorise
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits or restrictions on disposable / single-use virtual cards
criteria.edit_personal_details: change or update personal details (name, address, phone, email) on the account
criteria.exchange_charge: fees or charges for exchanging currency
criteria.exchange_rate: asks what the exchange rate is, how exchange rates are determined
criteria.exchange_via_app: exchanging currencies in the app, can I exchange currency via app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: unexplained charge or extra small amount on the statement (e.g. 'charged an extra pound', 'unknown charge of $1'), not clearly about a fee for a card payment or transfer
criteria.failed_transfer: transfer or payment failed or didn't go through; general 'why can I not make a transfer'; an error appears when trying to make a payment or transfer (e.g. a large payment such as buying a flat)
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies are supported, can I hold/exchange a given currency
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get / create a disposable virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: how to get a physical card, where to get one; also how to find the PIN or why a card or its PIN has not been received ('Where is my PIN', 'How do I find the PIN')
criteria.getting_spare_card: asks for a spare / additional / second card, or using a card for a family member / another person
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a (non-disposable) virtual card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone lost or stolen, worried about account access on the lost phone
criteria.order_physical_card: wants to order a physical card, how to order, fees for a physical card; asks about delivery of cards in general, without naming a country ('where can the cards be delivered?', 'do you ship your cards anywhere?')
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot passcode / password to login to app
criteria.pending_card_payment: card payment is still pending; asks when a payment will go through / why a payment hasn't gone through yet
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: cash withdrawal is still pending; also 'I didn't receive my money and it says the transaction is still in progress'
criteria.pending_transfer: the customer's own transfer is pending / not completed / has been waiting some time: how long it stays pending, 'waiting forever, why is it taking so long', 'tell me how long my urgent transfer will take', when will the transaction post, an outgoing transaction. Not for money that is missing from the balance after a transfer
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after wrong attempts, locked out of PIN
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money into the account, how to get paid, receive a transfer, can the app take my salary
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: refund has not shown up in the account yet, waiting for a refund
criteria.request_refund: wants to request a refund or get money back from a payment; wants to cancel a purchase ('I no longer want this, can I cancel my purchase?')
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: card payment was reverted / cancelled / returned back to the account, payment didn't go through and money came back
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards and currencies are supported for the account or for top-up; complaint that a specific card type (e.g. American Express) does not work for adding money; 'I want to add funds, what payment methods are accepted?'
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up the account with cash or cheque
criteria.top_up_failed: top up failed or didn't work
criteria.top_up_reverted: top up was reverted / returned / money disappeared after top up
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up / add money using a credit or debit card (including 'transfer funds using my credit card', top up online with card); whether other people can top up my account
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: a transaction / payment was charged twice, duplicate charge
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: charged a fee for a transfer
criteria.transfer_into_account: asks in general what ways are OK to add money to the account (no card mentioned), or how to transfer money into my account by bank transfer, or has problems transferring into the account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: a transfer was sent but the recipient (person or retailer) has not received it yet, even after waiting days
criteria.transfer_timing: general question about how long transfers take, or how much longer to wait for an incoming transfer from abroad (e.g. from the US); no complaint about the customer's own transfer being pending
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: unable to verify identity, identity verification failing or not working
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, what is needed to verify identity / documents
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying source of funds / where the money comes from, proof of source of funds
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a top-up: why do I need to verify to top up, the verification code for a top-up by card, 3D secure, 'verification code for my card transfer'
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: is the card Visa or Mastercard, which network can I choose; wanting to get a Visa or Mastercard card
criteria.why_verify_identity: why do you need to verify my identity / why so much personal info; do I have to verify who I am
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave wrong amount of cash, received less/more cash than requested
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
